text:
Iris Moreno: Doing a quick pass on the dashboard filter toolbar and the project modal. Found a couple a11y nits: filter chips have no keyboard focus state, filter dropdown not announced by VoiceOver when opened, and the project modal traps focus after close sometimes. Attaching notes.

Diego Alvarez: Thanks Iris. Can you jot down the exact markup/attrs you saw?

Iris Moreno: Sure. Filter chip markup: `<button class="filter-chip">Open</button>` no aria-pressed, no focus style. Dropdown uses `div[role="listbox"]` but when you open it VoiceOver says "listbox" but doesn't read selected option because no `aria-activedescendant`. Modal close flow: we focus close button, hit Esc, modal hides but focus stays in DOM focusable element behind it sometimes (likely a timing race with the animation).

Kai Thompson: For chips we should: 1) make them buttons with `aria-pressed` for toggle filters, 2) add visible focus ring (not outline removed), and 3) add `aria-label` for shorthand states when label is only an icon. Example: `<button class="filter-chip" aria-pressed="false">Open</button>` + CSS: `:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(2,112,255,0.2); outline: none; }`.

Sophie Li: On the dropdown: if we keep listbox pattern, add `aria-activedescendant` and manage roving focus internally. Or switch to native `select` if we don't need multi-select. Roving pattern is fine but needs keyboard support for Arrow keys, Home/End.

A11yBot: Automated scan: missing aria-pressed on 7 filter chips, missing aria-activedescendant on 2 listboxes, 1 focus-trap race detected on /console/dashboard. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/a11y/1852007890

Diego Alvarez: Modal race: could call `focus()` on the element that should receive focus after the close animation finishes. Also set `aria-hidden=true` on the modal root when closed so SRs don't jump. Example: `modalRoot.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');` then after animation remove from DOM.

Iris Moreno: Good call. Also noticed contrast issue on status badges in the toolbar: gray text `#6b7280` on `#f7f7f8` for small caps is ~3.2:1. We should increase to `#4b5563` or add a filled token.

Kai Thompson: I can put together a tiny PR with these: add aria-pressed for chips + keyboard focus styles, listbox aria-activedescendant support, modal close focus fix + aria-hidden toggling, and bumped badge color token. Will also add automated unit tests for aria attributes. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Sophie Li: Test matrix before merge: Keyboard-only (mac+windows), VoiceOver and NVDA sweeps, color contrast check, and a quick run of the e2e modal test to catch the timing. I'll review the PR.

Iris Moreno: Also please avoid removing outline globally — we keep outlines for accessibility. If we use box-shadow for aesthetics that's okay but don't hide focus.

Diego Alvarez: Noted. Creating ticket DG-A11Y-487 and attaching screenshots + short clips.

A11yBot: Reminder: a11y review meeting Friday 11am PT. Added this thread to the agenda. :spiral_calendar_pad:
